sources.basis: Supporting Tables S1, S8, S29-S30: historical hardware, original electrolyte and operation. The updated archive corrects V2O5 but explicitly warns of another unspecified error; its processes are not imported wholesale.
VOS16, issue 1, 2024-08-02: nominal 1.6 M V, 4.2 M total sulfate, density 1.36 kg/L, 50:50 V(III)/V(IV). Select 0.05 M H3PO4 from its customer-specific 0.05-0.12 M range.

Electrochemical V(V) reduction with oxygen evolution. Table 6: 1.69 kWh per kg ELEMENTAL VANADIUM at 50 mA/cm2 and 30 degC. Equation 5 establishes this denominator. Applying it to the 4.2 M sulfate product is an explicit process proxy; study electrolyte uses 4 M sulfate. Peripheral energy and electrode/membrane/factory wear are coverage gaps.

Equations 1-3: paired one-electron V half-reactions, 1.25 V standard cell potential. Use 1.25 V as a transparent nominal reference, not a measured cycle-average voltage or a claimed commercial performance.

limits: Independent reconstruction with stated engineering assumptions. The authors' unspecified remaining-error warning is not resolved or attributed to a particular cause. No author contact was made.

Historical hardware and current documented solution specification are combined as a reference model. No measured full-system discharge curve, current density, power rating or temperature management is revalidated.

Compute nominal gross DC-equivalent capacity from paired vanadium charge at the stated reference voltage. Do not equate the source's inconsistent 8.3 MWh label, 6 MWh usable output and 19.4 Wh/kg with this reconstruction.
The legacy assembly name containing 8.3 megawatt hour remains a stable identifier only. Capacity is derived from charge, not that name.
Component rows sum to 319950 kg, 2 kg above the printed 319948 kg total. Use the row sum for installed mass; one lifetime stack replacement is included separately.
Stoichiometric pure-equivalent feeds at complete conversion; no new metallurgical yields or primary/secondary shares. Existing upstream vanadium route limitations remain.
For electrochemical preparation, emitted O2 = 1.5/4 mol per mol V. Water closes product plus O2 mass, allowing for water implicit in the 85% phosphoric-acid supplier.
Legacy transport distances are retained as route proxies, but freight follows the corrected V2O5 shipment mass. No source archive recycling parameters are adopted.
The VRFB-specific waste market matches installed material plus the replacement stack. Existing treatment recipes and generic other-chemistry waste market are preserved.
Fixed design at all years. The generic mixed-storage consumer's throughput allocation remains a separate limitation; no complete system metal-result correction is claimed.
